title: skill-frontmatter — IS OVERLAY (authored by Intent Solutions)
description: The Intent-Solutions-only delta on top of upstream-base/skill-frontmatter.v1.json. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE IS POLICY LIVES for this contract. It promotes four upstream-optional fields (allowed-tools, license, compatibility) to IS-required, adds three net-new IS-required tracking fields (version, author, tags), narrows a few types, and declares the optional IS extension fields. By the monotonic-additive invariant (DR-044 D7 + CSO position): the overlay may only ADD required fields and NARROW constraints relative to the base — never subtract a base requirement or loosen a base constraint. Each field below carries its upstream-convergence trigger: the condition under which the field MOVES from this overlay into upstream-base (a mechanical move, not a re-edit).
$comment: OVERLAY REQUIRED DELTA (beyond the base floor [name, description]): [allowed-tools, version, author, license, compatibility, tags]. Union with the base floor = the IS 8-field marketplace required set {name, description, allowed-tools, version, author, license, compatibility, tags} — the SCHEMA_CHANGELOG NON-NEGOTIABLE. Evolves under ISEDC Class-1 ratification only (must not be silently reduced — the 2026-04-28 debacle guard). Citations: 6767-b §4 (the 3-layer split + the NON-NEGOTIABLE 8-field set); skill-creator references/frontmatter-spec.md.

x-mutually-exclusive-fields.$comment: kyh9 cross-field invariant (CTO re-scope of the original infeasible cross-field bead). requires_env and fallback_for_env are mutually exclusive PER VARIABLE: a single identifier must not appear in BOTH arrays (a variable cannot be declared required-present AND simultaneously carry a fallback). This is an array-element-disjointness predicate, which vanilla JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot express (no cross-array intersection keyword; ajv can only do it with the non-standard `$data` extension, which would break the language-agnostic wire contract and silently no-op for any standard validator). DOCUMENTED CARVE-OUT per the CTO ruling: the predicate is enforced in the Zod runtime layer (generated from this annotation by codegen-authoring.ts) and is intentionally NOT mirrored in the published JSON Schema. The fold-agreement (ajv ↔ Zod) backstop carves out exactly these overlap cases — see src/__tests__/skill-frontmatter-schema.test.ts.

allowed-tools.$comment: IS: promoted from upstream-OPTIONAL to IS-REQUIRED. Type accepts EITHER a CSV/space-delimited STRING (the upstream prose form — 6767-h §3.1 / agentskills.io EXPERIMENTAL space-separated string — and the form the entire published-plugin corpus authors) OR a YAML array of tool identifiers. Non-breaking SUPERSET relaxation (v0.4.1): array-authored skills stay valid AND string-authored skills now validate too, faithful to the upstream string form. Resolves the 23% CCP kernel-shadow deviation (836/838 disagreements were this single field rejecting the corpus string form). An empty array is valid (a skill that pre-approves zero tools); an empty string is likewise valid. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if agentskills.io promotes allowed-tools out of EXPERIMENTAL and into its required set, move the required-membership to upstream-base. The base STILL does not type allowed-tools — the union now MATCHES the upstream string form rather than narrowing it, so the overlay's only remaining delta is REQUIRED-membership plus the additional array form.

version.$comment: IS: net-new IS-required tracking field (NOT a top-level agentskills.io field; the standard only allows metadata.version). Strict SemVer 2.0.0 — stricter than the legacy IS validator's prefix match (which accepted 1.2.3.4 / 1.2.3-anything-unanchored). CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if agentskills.io adds a top-level required `version`, move it to upstream-base.

author.$comment: IS: net-new IS-required tracking field (the standard only allows metadata.author). CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if agentskills.io adds a top-level required `author`, move it to upstream-base.

tags.$comment: IS: net-new IS-required tracking field with ZERO upstream provenance — not in agentskills.io (not even under metadata) nor any Anthropic surface. Pure IS invention; convergence is unlikely. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: only if the open standard introduces a top-level `tags` array.

license.$comment: IS: promoted from upstream-OPTIONAL to IS-REQUIRED (type unchanged from base). CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if agentskills.io makes license required, move the required-membership to upstream-base.

compatibility.$comment: IS: promoted from upstream-OPTIONAL to IS-REQUIRED (type unchanged from base). CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if agentskills.io makes compatibility required, move the required-membership to upstream-base.

requires_env.$comment: IS OPTIONAL extension (validator schema 3.5.0). Environment variables this skill needs. Cross-field invariant (an identifier must not appear in both requires_env and fallback_for_env) is enforced PER VARIABLE in the Zod runtime layer via the x-mutually-exclusive-fields annotation above (kyh9 — generated by codegen-authoring.ts as a documented carve-out; not structurally expressible in vanilla JSON Schema).

requires_tools.$comment: IS OPTIONAL extension (3.5.0). Tools this skill needs.

required_environment_variables.$comment: IS OPTIONAL extension (validator schema 3.6.0). Each entry prompts the user on first run. name is UPPER_SNAKE_CASE; name + prompt are required per entry.
